summary: DressupMirror drops the 'Reference' MirrorAxis value, renames the Reference property to ReferenceOffset (which now auto-selects the mirror axis from the picked edge), changes CenterModel and reference offsets to mirror about the shape's bounding-box center, alters which properties are hidden, and adds a scripting Create() function.

pages.reason: Path/Dressup/Gui/Mirror.py: MirrorAxis enumeration becomes ('X','Y','XY','None'); property 'Reference' renamed 'ReferenceOffset' with new tooltip and auto-sets MirrorAxis via setMirrorAxis(); setEditorModes now hides only ReferenceOffset when CenterModel is set (CenterModel/KeepBasePath no longer hidden); execute() now offsets by 2*bb.Center (not XMax+Placement) so mirrored output changes; new module-level Create(baseObject, name, mode) replaces the inline doCommand sequence
